SUMMARY: This factory builds a single star coral: an icosphere base is converted to a dual mesh, sculpted, and decorated with radial "flower"/star-shaped polyp clusters whose rings extrude outward, then covered in dense star-shaped tentacles. StarCoralFactory (generate.py) wraps StarBaseCoralFactory (star.py) with a shared coral shader and optional bump/noise/tentacle passes. The other coral files in the package are unused variants for StarCoral but define the shared BaseCoralFactory API, tentacle system, and shader that this factory relies on.

EDITABLE (upper-level files — change these to alter the result):

FILE: assets/objects/corals/generate.py
  CoralFactory.create_asset: top-level assembly; scales base, remeshes, assigns material, adds bump/noise, conditionally adds tentacles.
    knobs: obj.scale uniform(0.8,1.2,3) (random) -> per-instance size jitter; face_size(0.01) -> mesh density; has_bump = uniform<bump_prob -> chooses noise-vs-bump displacement; tentacle gate uniform<tentacle_prob and not has_bump -> whether tentacles appear.
  CoralFactory.apply_noise_texture: fine surface displacement.
    knobs: type choice ["STUCCI","MARBLE"] (random); noise_scale log_uniform(0.01,0.02); strength = noise_strength*uniform(0.9,1.2).
  CoralFactory.apply_bump: voronoi bump displacement.
    knobs: noise_scale log_uniform(0.02,0.03); noise_intensity log_uniform(1.5,2); minkovsky_exponent uniform(1,1.5); strength = -noise_strength*uniform(1,2).
  CoralFactory.build_base_hue: base hue selection.
    knobs: 0.25 prob -> full-range hue uniform(0,1); else uniform(-0.2,0.3)%1 (pink/red/orange band). Lower band center to bias toward pink cores.
  CoralFactory.shader_coral: coral surface material (base_hue fed in).
    knobs: shift uniform(0.05,0.1)*±1 -> hue variation between dark/bright; subsurface_color hsv2rgba(random,random,1.0); bright_color sat uniform(0.7,0.9) val 0.2; dark_color sat uniform(0.5,0.7) val 0.1; light_color hue jitter uniform(-0.2,0.2) sat uniform(0.2,0.4) val 0.4; specular uniform(0.25,0.5); color_ramp musgrave uniform(10,20) with stops [0,0.3,0.7,1]; light mix curve knee uniform(0.3,0.4); roughness curve (0->0.5,1->1.0); subsurface_ratio uniform(0,0.05) 50% else 0 -> pink-core glow; subsurface_radius uniform(0.05,0.2).
  StarCoralFactory: binds StarBaseCoralFactory as the base geometry maker (no knobs).

FILE: assets/objects/corals/star.py
  StarBaseCoralFactory (class attrs): overall polyp behavior.
    knobs: tentacle_prob(1.0) -> always tentacled; noise_strength(0.002) -> subtle surface displacement magnitude; density(3000) -> tentacle point count (very dense).
  StarBaseCoralFactory.points_fn: restricts tentacles to "outermost" ring band (fixed).
  geo_dual_mesh: base mesh perturbation before dualing.
    knobs: perturb(0.05) -> random vertex jitter amount.
  geo_separate_faces: splits/scales top faces into polyp seeds.
    knobs: selection z>0 (fixed hemisphere); scale uniform(0.9,1.2) -> polyp face size.
  geo_flower: extrudes each ring into a star-shaped polyp cluster.
    knobs: anchor (built in create_asset) controls float-curve peak; outer band 0.4<t<0.6 tags "outermost".
  StarBaseCoralFactory.create_asset: builds star coral.
    knobs: icosphere subdivisions(3) -> base resolution; location z uniform(0.25,0.5) -> dome height; displace_vertices factor -0.9 -> flatten underside; SUBSURF levels(3) twice -> smoothness; resolution(16) -> polyp radial segments; empty scale uniform(0.3,0.5)^(1/res) -> polyp taper; anchor=(uniform(0.4,0.6), uniform(0.08,0.15)) -> polyp bulge position/depth.

FILE: assets/objects/corals/tentacles.py
  build_tentacles: geometry of each star-shaped tentacle instance.
    knobs: n_branch(5), n_major(8); path std(0.5) momentum(0.5) sz(0.008); spawn init_vec sample_direction(0.6) -> spread; build_radius_tree base radius uniform(0.002,0.004).
  make_radius_points_fn / make_upward_points_fn / make_min_distance_points_fn: tentacle placement filters (min_distance, radius_threshold, max_angle).
  geo_tentacles: instances tentacles on distributed points.
    knobs: density(default 500, overridden to 3000); instance Scale uniform([0.6]*3,[1.0]*3); rotation random 0..2pi.
  shader_tentacles: tentacle material.
    knobs: roughness(0.8); specular(0.25); color hue jitter uniform(-0.1,0.1) sat uniform(0.4,0.6) val 0.5; fresnel_color hsv2rgba(random,0.6,0.6); subsurface 0.01.
  apply: builds asset collection of 5 tentacle variants (count=5) and applies to obj.

FILE: assets/objects/corals/base.py
  BaseCoralFactory: default coral parameters inherited by all bases.
    knobs: tentacle_distance(0.05); default_scale([0.8]*3); noise_strength(0.02); tentacle_prob(0.5); bump_prob(0.3); density(500) — StarBase overrides several.

FILE: assets/objects/corals/__init__.py
  Re-exports all coral factory classes (no tunables).

FILE: assets/objects/corals/{diff_growth,elkhorn,fan,laplacian,reaction_diffusion,tree,tube}.py
  Alternate coral base factories NOT used by StarCoralFactory; editable only if you switch factory_method. Each exposes its own geometry knobs (branch counts, feed/kill rates, growth vectors, etc.).

FILE: assets/objects/trees/tree.py
  build_radius_tree / recursive_path / rand_path: procedural branch skeleton used to build tentacle instances.
    knobs: rand_path std/momentum/sz/sz_decay -> branch waviness/length; radius_fn scaling.

LINKED TO INFINIGEN (infra — do NOT edit, resolved from the original package):
  core/placement/factory.py -> AssetFactory base + make_asset_collection.
  core/placement/detail.py -> remesh_with_attrs for face-size control.
  core/surface.py -> shaderfunc_to_material, add_geomod, eval_argument.
  core/nodes/node_wrangler.py, node_info.py, node_utils.py, utils.py -> geometry/shader node graph construction (build_color_ramp, musgrave, etc.).
  core/nodes/nodegroups/transfer_attributes.py -> attribute transfer node group.
  core/nodes/compatibility.py -> Blender version node compat.
  core/tagging.py, core/tags.py -> tag_object / COMBINED_ATTR_NAME semantic tagging.
  core/util/blender.py -> mesh/modifier/object helpers (butil).
  core/util/color.py -> hsv2rgba color conversion.
  core/util/math.py -> FixedSeed deterministic seeding.
  core/util/random.py -> log_uniform sampling.
  core/util/logging.py -> logging.
  assets/utils/object.py -> new_icosphere, new_circle, mesh2obj, data2mesh, join_objects, new_empty, origin2lowest, etc.
  assets/utils/decorate.py -> geo_extension, displace_vertices, read_co/write_co, remove_vertices, subsurface2face_size.
  assets/utils/draw.py -> shape_by_angles, make_circular_interp.
  assets/utils/mesh.py -> polygon_angles, treeify, build_convex_mesh, init_mesh.
  assets/utils/misc.py -> assign_material, sample_direction.
  assets/utils/nodegroup.py -> geo_radius, geo_radius node groups.
  assets/utils/laplacian.py -> build_laplacian_3d (unused by star).
  assets/utils/reaction_diffusion.py -> reaction_diffusion helpers (unused by star).
  assets/utils/shortest_path.py -> geo_shortest_path (unused by star).
  infinigen_gpl/extras/diff_growth.py -> build_diff_growth (unused by star).
  assets/objects/trees/utils/* (geometrynodes, helper, mesh) -> tree skeleton nodegroups and helpers used by build_radius_tree.
